from pathlib import Path
import collections
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_ids = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != bg]
    ordinary = [r for r in range(h) if r not in row_ids]
    col_ids = [c for c in range(w) if ordinary and Counter(grid[r][c] for r in ordinary).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    lattice = [[grid[r][c] for c in col_ids] for r in row_ids]
    if not lattice or not lattice[0]:
        return [[bg]]
    default = Counter(v for row in lattice for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    while len(lattice) > 1 and all(v == default for v in lattice[-1]):
        lattice.pop()
    while len(lattice[0]) > 1 and all(row[-1] == default for row in lattice):
        lattice = [row[:-1] for row in lattice]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(lattice)-1):
        line = []
        for c in range(len(lattice[0])-1):
            block = (lattice[r][c], lattice[r][c+1], lattice[r+1][c], lattice[r+1][c+1])
            line.append(block[0] if block.count(block[0]) == 4 and block[0] != default else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_ids = [r for r in range(h) if Counter(grid[r]).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    ordinary = [r for r in range(h) if r not in row_ids]
    col_ids = [c for c in range(w) if ordinary and Counter(grid[r][c] for r in ordinary).most_common(1)[0][0] != bg]
    lattice = [[grid[r][c] for c in col_ids] for r in row_ids]
    if not lattice or not lattice[0]:
        return [[bg]]
    # The repeated separator color on non-data rows is the default lattice color.
    separator_values = [grid[r][c] for r in ordinary for c in col_ids]
    default = Counter(separator_values).most_common(1)[0][0] if separator_values else Counter(v for row in lattice for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    while len(lattice) > 1 and all(v == default for v in lattice[-1]):
        lattice.pop()
    while len(lattice[0]) > 1 and all(row[-1] == default for row in lattice):
        lattice = [row[:-1] for row in lattice]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(lattice)-1):
        line = []
        for c in range(len(lattice[0])-1):
            block = (lattice[r][c], lattice[r][c+1], lattice[r+1][c], lattice[r+1][c+1])
            line.append(block[0] if block.count(block[0]) == 4 and block[0] != default else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
